001package com.streamconverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamConverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SampleStreamCommand;
006import com.streamConverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
007import com.streamConverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand;
008import com.streamConverter.command.impl.xml.XmlNavigateCommand;
009import com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
010import com.streamConverter.path.CSVPath;
011import com.streamConverter.path.TreePath;
012import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
013import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
014import java.io.IOException;
015import java.io.InputStream;
016import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
017import org.slf4j.Logger;
018import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
019
020/**
021 * Comprehensive demo application for StreamConverter.
022 *
023 * <p>This demo showcases various features of the StreamConverter including: - CSV navigation and
024 * column selection - JSON navigation with TreePath-like expressions - XML navigation with TreePath
025 * expressions - Command chaining and pipeline processing
026 */
027public class StreamConverterDemo {
028
029  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(StreamConverterDemo.class);
030
031  /**
032   * アプリケーションのエントリーポイント。StreamConverterのデモを実行します。
033   *
034   * @param args コマンドライン引数（使用されません）
035   */
036  public static void main(String[] args) {
037    logger.info("=== StreamConverter Demo Application ===\n");
038
039    try {
040      // Demo 1: CSV Navigation
041      demoCSVNavigation();
042
043      // Demo 2: JSON Navigation
044      demoJSONNavigation();
045
046      // Demo 3: XML Navigation
047      demoXMLNavigation();
048
049      // Demo 4: Command Pipeline
050      demoCommandPipeline();
051
052      // Demo 5: Complex Processing Chain
053      demoComplexProcessing();
054
055    } catch (Exception e) {
056      logger.error("Demo failed: " + e.getMessage());
057      e.printStackTrace();
058    }
059  }
060
061  private static void demoCSVNavigation() throws IOException {
062    logger.info("📊 CSV Navigation Demo");
063    logger.info("======================");
064
065    String csvData =
066        """
067        name,age,city,salary
068        John Doe,30,New York,50000
069        Jane Smith,25,Los Angeles,60000
070        Bob Johnson,35,Chicago,55000
071        Alice Brown,28,Houston,52000
072        """;
073
074    // Demo 1a: Extract specific column by name
075    logger.info("1. Extract 'name' column:");
076    runDemo(csvData, CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()));
077
078    // Demo 1b: Extract column by index
079    logger.info("\n2. Extract column at index 2 (city):");
080    runDemo(csvData, CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("2"), new PassThroughRule()));
081
082    // Demo 1c: Process name column (first column by name)
083    logger.info("\n3. Process name column:");
084    runDemo(csvData, CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()));
085
086    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(50) + "\n");
087  }
088
089  private static void demoJSONNavigation() throws IOException {
090    logger.info("🔍 JSON Navigation Demo");
091    logger.info("========================");
092
093    String jsonData =
094        """
095        {"users":[{"name":"John","age":30,"city":"NYC"},{"name":"Jane","age":25,"city":"LA"}],"total":2}
096        """;
097
098    // Demo 2a: Extract specific property
099    logger.info("1. Extract 'total' property:");
100    runDemo(jsonData, JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromXml("total"), new PassThroughRule()));
101
102    // Demo 2b: Navigate nested properties
103    logger.info("\n2. Navigate to users array:");
104    runDemo(jsonData, JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromXml("users"), new PassThroughRule()));
105
106    // Demo 2c: Format root JSON
107    logger.info("\n3. Format root JSON:");
108    runDemo(jsonData, JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromJson("$"), new PassThroughRule()));
109
110    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(50) + "\n");
111  }
112
113  private static void demoXMLNavigation() throws IOException {
114    logger.info("🌲 XML Navigation Demo");
115    logger.info("======================");
116
117    String xmlData =
118        """
119        <?xml version="1.0"?>
120        <users>
121          <user>
122            <name>John</name>
123            <age>30</age>
124            <city>NYC</city>
125          </user>
126          <user>
127            <name>Jane</name>
128            <age>25</age>
129            <city>LA</city>
130          </user>
131        </users>
132        """;
133
134    // Demo 3a: Extract specific elements
135    logger.info("1. Extract all 'name' elements:");
136    runDemo(
137        xmlData,
138        XmlNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromXml("users/user/name"), new PassThroughRule()));
139
140    // Demo 3b: Extract user elements
141    logger.info("\n2. Extract all 'user' elements:");
142    runDemo(
143        xmlData, XmlNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromXml("users/user"), new PassThroughRule()));
144
145    // Demo 3c: Process root XML
146    logger.info("\n3. Process root XML:");
147    runDemo(xmlData, XmlNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromXml("//users"), new PassThroughRule()));
148
149    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(50) + "\n");
150  }
151
152  private static void demoCommandPipeline() throws IOException {
153    logger.info("🔗 Command Pipeline Demo");
154    logger.info("=========================");
155
156    String jsonData =
157        """
158        {"users":[{"name":"John","age":30},{"name":"Jane","age":25}],"total":2}
159        """;
160
161    // Demo 4: Chain JSON formatting with sample processing
162    logger.info("1. JSON formatting → Sample processing:");
163    IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
164      JsonNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromJson("$"), new PassThroughRule()), // Format JSON
165      new SampleStreamCommand("formatter") // Add processing info
166    };
167
168    runDemo(jsonData, pipeline);
169
170    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(50) + "\n");
171  }
172
173  private static void demoComplexProcessing() throws IOException {
174    logger.info("⚙️ Complex Processing Demo");
175    logger.info("===========================");
176
177    String csvData =
178        """
179        name,age,city
180        John,30,NYC
181        Jane,25,LA
182        Bob,35,Chicago
183        """;
184
185    // Demo 5: Multi-stage processing
186    logger.info("1. Multi-stage CSV processing:");
187    IStreamCommand[] complexPipeline = {
188      CsvNavigateCommand.create(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule()), // Extract names
189      new SampleStreamCommand("name-processor"), // Process names
190      new SampleStreamCommand("final-formatter") // Final formatting
191    };
192
193    runDemo(csvData, complexPipeline);
194
195    logger.info("\n" + "=".repeat(50) + "\n");
196  }
197
198  private static void runDemo(String inputData, IStreamCommand command) throws IOException {
199    runDemo(inputData, new IStreamCommand[] {command});
200  }
201
202  private static void runDemo(String inputData, IStreamCommand[] commands) throws IOException {
203    try (InputStream inputStream =
204            new ByteArrayInputStream(inputData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
205        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
206
207      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(commands);
208      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
209
210      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
211      logger.info("Input:");
212      logger.info(inputData.trim());
213      logger.info("\nOutput:");
214      logger.info(result.trim());
215    }
216  }
217}
